scripts.types: wrangler types --config wrangler.slot.jsonc --env-interface SlotEnv --include-runtime false --strict-vars false src/slot-env.d.ts && wrangler types --config wrangler.router.jsonc --env-interface RouterEnv --include-runtime false --strict-vars false src/router-env.d.ts
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run types && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:slot:blue && npm run check:slot:green && npm run check:router

scripts.deploy:slot:green: npm run build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.slot.jsonc --env green --strict
